اخلولقت (form XII)

# اِخْلَوْلَقْتِ (iḵlawlaqti) /ix.law.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْلَوْلَقَ (iḵlawlaqa)
# اِخْلَوْلَقَتْ (iḵlawlaqat) /ix
